_doc: THE per-agent control flags for the agent-swap gate (Z-87a). Same vocabulary as steem/agent/lib/fleet-roster.cjs control flags (full/partial/operator-delegated/blocked-no-key + economicUse). STRUCTURAL LAW: an agent not listed here is blocked-no-key + economicUse:false (fail-closed). Arming an agent = owner edits this file (or sets AGENT_SWAP_ROSTER_PATH) — an explicit, committed, auditable owner act. The gate ALSO requires the owner-armed signing env + book-law clamp pass; flags alone never arm anything.

default.blockedReason: not individually flagged — no economic use
